tex_content.html:
Corollary
Source: topping:page-0120 ↗ topping-ch9-ricci-pinching-preserved 1. ch9:7.6,ch9:7.7\group curvature-pinching

On a closed three-dimensional manifold, Ricci flow preserves $\Ric >\varepsilon Rg$ for $\varepsilon \in [0,\tfrac 13)$, as well as $\Ric \ge 0$ and $\Ric >0$.
